categories.main_business_segments: Walsin Lihwa Corporation operates primarily in four business segments: Wire and Cable, Stainless Steel, Resources, and Commercial Real Estate. The Wire and Cable segment manufactures and sells copper wires, electrical wires, cables, and related accessories. The Stainless Steel segment focuses on forging, processing, and selling various stainless steel products including billets, coils, rods, and seamless pipes. The Resources segment produces and sells upstream raw materials such as nickel pig iron and nickel matte, and also provides agency sales of stainless steel semi-finished products. The Commercial Real Estate segment involves leasing office buildings and commercial properties.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including vacuum melting and remelting for stainless steel and nickel-based alloys, intelligent manufacturing systems such as automated guided vehicles and smart power consumption monitoring, and green energy technologies like pure oxygen preheaters and green hydrogen production. It also develops high-voltage cables for offshore wind turbines and submarine cables, and applies specialized heat treatment and alloy design for high-performance stainless steel products. The company integrates Industry 4.0 automation and digital intelligence in production processes to enhance efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Walsin Lihwa serves a diverse customer base including power generation and transmission companies, industrial manufacturers, construction and infrastructure sectors, automotive and aerospace industries, and new energy sectors such as battery manufacturers. Its stainless steel products cater to global markets including Taiwan, Mainland China, Europe, Southeast Asia, and the Americas. The wire and cable products primarily serve domestic and Mainland China markets, while the resources segment supplies raw materials to steel mills and battery material producers. The commercial real estate segment targets office tenants and retail operators in Nanjing, China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in Taiwan, Mainland China, Indonesia, Italy, Germany, Luxembourg, Singapore, Malaysia, and the United States. It has manufacturing plants in Taiwan (multiple locations), Mainland China, Indonesia, and Europe, with subsidiaries in Italy, Germany, Luxembourg, and Singapore. Its sales and marketing reach global markets including Asia, Europe, North and South America. The commercial real estate business is concentrated in Nanjing, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Walsin Lihwa operates across multiple points in the supply chain, including upstream raw material production (nickel pig iron and nickel matte), midstream stainless steel manufacturing and processing, and downstream wire and cable production. It also engages in agency sales of raw materials and semi-finished products, and provides engineering and contracting services for high-voltage and submarine cables. The company integrates vertically by controlling raw material sources and extending into high-value product applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-value and high-end product development, including advanced stainless steel and nickel-based alloys for aerospace, energy, and automotive applications. It invests in intelligent manufacturing, green energy technologies such as green hydrogen production, and environmental sustainability initiatives. R&D efforts focus on developing high-voltage cables for offshore wind turbines, submarine cables, and wire harnesses for new energy vehicles. The company also emphasizes digital transformation, Industry 4.0 automation, and sustainable development aligned with ESG goals.
categories.revenue_model: Walsin Lihwa generates revenue primarily through product sales of wire and cable, stainless steel products, and raw materials like nickel pig iron and nickel matte. It also earns income from leasing commercial real estate properties. The company engages in agency sales and procurement services for metal raw materials. Revenue is derived from both domestic and international markets, with a focus on long-term contracts, project-based engineering services, and high-value product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the stainless steel sector, Walsin Lihwa ranks among the top global producers of stainless steel long products, competing with major players like Tsingshan and Jiangsu Delong. It holds significant market shares in Taiwan and China and competes in niche high-end markets in Europe and globally. In the wire and cable industry, it maintains leadership in Taiwan's power cable and copper bar markets, facing competition from domestic and international cable manufacturers. The resources segment competes in nickel pig iron and nickel matte production, primarily in Indonesia, against other regional producers. The company leverages vertical integration and technological innovation to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Walsin Lihwa reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$179.3 billion, with a net income after taxes of NT$2.8 billion and earnings per share of NT$0.69. The company experienced a 5.5% revenue decline due to weak global demand but has maintained profitability in the wire and cable segment. It has shown growth over the past four years prior to 2024. The company invests heavily in R&D with expenditures around NT$600 million recently and plans capital investments exceeding NT$2 billion for future development. It has a large workforce exceeding 11,000 employees and operates multiple subsidiaries worldwide.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Walsin Lihwa emphasizes high-quality, high-value-added products with a focus on advanced applications such as aerospace, energy, and new energy vehicles. Its vertical integration from raw materials to finished products ensures stable supply and cost competitiveness. The company differentiates through technological innovation, intelligent manufacturing, and sustainable practices including green energy and carbon reduction initiatives. It offers comprehensive solutions including engineering services for high-voltage and submarine cables, and maintains strong brand recognition and customer satisfaction in its core markets.
